title: VEL-LANG-001: Codex main-based integration of PR #77, preserving ChatGPT origins
body:
## Owner-selected implementation dispatch — 18 October 2026

**Implementer: Codex (ADR-0008 default). Reviewer/coordinator: ChatGPT. Final owner approval and merge remain separate.** This issue relays the owner's explicit choice: “Codex implementation: Dispatch Codex to perform a new integration against current `main`, preserving the original ChatGPT-authored content.” This is a coordinator-posted relay through the owner's connected GitHub account, **not** a claim that the owner independently posted this issue or already approved product terminology.

### Verified starting points
- Repo: `Ben-001-sys/Vellistry`; current `main` at dispatch inspection: `098ab06a40a84eaba5880223f02e80fab3bf9e86` (PR #78 merged). **Re-fetch `origin/main` and verify the actual start SHA immediately before creating a branch; if main advanced, anchor to the new verified main.**
- Historical [PR #77](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/pull/77) remains **DRAFT/UNMERGED**, head `3cb1030ae4c636fc18245ed8ae23ebb967e5407d`, branch `docs/vel-language-standard-20261017`; this predates the PR #76 governance merge. Do **not** rebase, force-push, cherry-pick the entire branch, edit, close, or merge PR #77.
- Historical source [LANGUAGE.md](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/blob/3cb1030ae4c636fc18245ed8ae23ebb967e5407d/LANGUAGE.md) is **ChatGPT-authored candidate text**, `status: proposed-owner-review`, with **15 owner-reserved terminology decisions**. Original [PR77 AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/blob/3cb1030ae4c636fc18245ed8ae23ebb967e5407d/AGENTS.md) contains a language-specific addition **and outdated governance text**; integrate only a narrow, compatible language-reference subsection into the newer **current-main** `AGENTS.md`.
- Historical corrective Task/CP/EB0012 and source map on PR77 must remain linkable evidence, *not* be recycled or misrepresented as a valid current-main handoff. Original ChatGPT execution must never be described as Codex execution.

### Required preflight and ordering
1. Work on a **new isolated branch from live `main`**, e.g. `codex/vel-lang-001-main-integration` (check for collision). Read `PROJECT-CONSTITUTION.md`, `SOURCE-OF-TRUTH.md`, `CURRENT-STATE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, accepted ADR-0008, `docs/agent-workflow/README.md`, `docs/agent-workflow/PR-COMPLIANCE.md`, merged checker and fixtures, and PR77 provenance.
2. Allocate a **fresh, unique Task/ContextPack/ExecutionBundle ID absent from the evaluated merge-base and not conflicting with existing main/other active work** (main already contains up to at least Task0015; do not assume 0013/0016 are free). Use this issue as the linked owner-selected bounded assignment. Record `change_base` equal to the actual evaluated merge-base SHA, phase, Codex executor, exact allow_paths, authorization URL/provenance/status/expiry and forbidden_actions per reviewed-base checker.
3. **Commit original source references/snapshot and task, then generate, validate and commit a complete immutable ContextPack before *any* operative edits** to `LANGUAGE.md` or `AGENTS.md`. Validate with the real repository tool, not reconstructed output. If chronology/permission cannot satisfy the checker, stop and report rather than backdate or alter controls.
4. Import/reconcile original ChatGPT-authored proposed language content by evidence-backed adoption. Preserve the original PR77 SHA/source links and `ChatGPT` original executor in the compliant `docs/agent-workflow/PR-COMPLIANCE.yaml` manifest and ExecutionBundle. `Codex` is only the *new integration executor*; do not relabel prior commits/content as originally Codex. Verify adopted Git patch/source against the repository's actual provenance rules and negative tests; do not falsify origin. Update only truly stale date/baseline wording if needed, with an explicitly documented Codex integration amendment.
5. Keep `LANGUAGE.md` **proposed-owner-review**, retain all 15 pending terminology/label decisions and existing author-control/canon/AI boundaries. No global UX label adoption, feature work, backend/schema/routes changes, or implied release of future functionality.
6. Merge **only** the applicable product-language reference into *current-main* `AGENTS.md`; preserve PR76+ effective policy, Codex-default instruction, base-anchored compliance and any newer main changes. Never overwrite main with PR77's older `AGENTS.md`.
7. After operative source commit: create a truthful ExecutionBundle with actual exact commands/results, HEAD/source SHA, changed paths, provenance and known gaps; update manifest according to the trusted checker, use a final report/manifest-only commit. Run `python scripts/agent_workflow.py validate`, `python -I scripts/run_pr_compliance.py` with the actual supported event arguments (inspect help/tests), applicable local checks and **exact-head GitHub CI**. Do not report green from stale/old-branch runs; rerun failed tests or report BLOCKED accurately.
8. Open a **new draft PR targeting `main`**, linking this issue and original PR #77; supply source, task/pack/EB, evidence and owner review checklist. Do not mark ready without genuine passing required checks. Owner decides terminology approval and merge separately.

### Intended path allowlist
New/updated `LANGUAGE.md`, narrowly scoped `AGENTS.md`, the fresh task YAML, pinned ContextPack, ExecutionBundle, `docs/agent-workflow/inputs/VEL-TASK-NEW/*` source/provenance snapshots, and canonical `docs/agent-workflow/PR-COMPLIANCE.yaml`. Expand only via owner authorization if the trusted checker requires additional specific evidence file paths. **No changes** to `.github/workflows/*`, `scripts/*`, `tests/*`, application/frontend, auth, SQL, migrations, dependencies, deployment, accepted ADRs, admin settings, or the old PR77 branch.

### Stop conditions / forbidden
No hosted DB or production, real/private manuscripts, secrets, paid services, admin/config/protection changes, releases or merges. No self-issued owner-verifiable executor exception, no CI bypass or new special bootstrap, no retrospective fake handoff, no untrue PASS. If main drift, an ID collision, missing scope/authorization, or provenance checker failure blocks compliance, **stop with an evidence-linked blocker** rather than silently change governance.

### Acceptance criteria
A new main-anchored Codex PR; immutable Task/ContextPack correctly ordered; original ChatGPT material and Git origin transparently preserved; PR76+ `AGENTS.md` policy retained; language labels still pending owner review; manifest/EB and genuine current-head validations; owner controls merge and semantic adoption.
